title: Point Utilities: range, scale, closest, path length
hints: Range: std::sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z). Avoid std::pow for squares.
scaleInPlace: `for (auto& p : cloud)` — the & is essential.
findClosest: compare SQUARED distances; keep a `const Point3*` initialised to nullptr.
pathLength: loop i from 1 to size() so you never compute size()-1 on an empty vector.
